data.rationale: The proposal matches the true flow of opening the form, typing and picking origin and destination, setting dates, clicking Find flights and selecting a fare, and it names the right parameters, including a miles option; it adds a few extra steps (passenger adjustments, seats) and leaves trip_type implicit, but it is concrete enough to automate.
